dialogues.speaker: Crossa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Must be my old sickness acting up, then.

dialogues.speaker: Crossa
dialogues.text: I used to be a sailor, but I was injured in an accident, and ever since, I've felt like my surroundings are shaking.

dialogues.speaker: Crossa
dialogues.text: I can't go back to being a sailor, so I can only help old friends sell things they salvage underwater to make a living.
